name: tidybyte-ios-tools
description: Release, screenshot, growth, and localization tooling for the TidyByte iOS app

scripts.archive: xcodebuild archive -project Tidybyte.xcodeproj -scheme Tidybyte -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -archivePath "$PWD/build/archive/Tidybyte.xcarchive" -derivedDataPath "$PWD/build/ArchiveDD" CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=HMWGCVU4SV && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath "$PWD/build/archive/Tidybyte.xcarchive" -exportPath "$PWD/build/archive/export" -exportOptionsPlist scripts/ExportOptions-export.plist
